# NakliOS

A browser desktop that brings your tools, files, and coding agents into one workspace.
Storage follows the selected backend: Browser, a picked folder, or encrypted Crate storage on the user's Cloudflare R2.
Agent inference sends requests to the configured endpoint. No NakliOS account or build step is required.
Live: https://naklios.dev — Source: https://github.com/NakliTechie/nakliOS (MIT).

## What it is
A desktop entrypoint at index.html that hosts bundled apps and links to standalone tools.
Immersive is the default: compatible apps open in windows. Basic keeps system apps hosted and opens other web apps in tabs.
Apps may ship additional modules and assets; declared mirrors preserve their upstream source and asset inventory.

## Apps (/apps/<id>/)
- anvil — browser coding agent with read/write/edit/shell tools and a configured inference endpoint
- forge — shell/desktop over Rig + Kiln
- reckon — spreadsheet; draft — word processor; editor; notes; files; menagerie — a fleet of coding agents in one tab, over relays you run
- reel — media player; nakliamp — music; sheaf — PDF editor; tijori — vault; calendar

## Runtime surface
- Host bridge: window.naklios (+ .ai) over postMessage; SDK at /sdk/naklios.js. Hosted transport requires a real host channel; standalone apps use their own fallback adapters. Events: naklios:ready, :title, :close, :beforeclose, :theme.
- Storage: Browser support is app-specific; File System Access uses a picked folder; Crate provides encrypted remote storage. Files has no Browser backend.
- AI: apps use the host broker (naklios.ai). General inference can use browser models or a configured endpoint; coding agents require the endpoint.
- Egress: naklios.net.fetch routes one cross-origin request through the user's own signed Cloudflare Worker (nakli-egress) — HMAC envelope, destination allowlist, SSRF guard. naklios never proxies traffic.

## Coding agents
- Rig (sys/rig): governed fileops, Git, registry, agent face, and a bounded Unix shell with byte streams and recursive permission analysis.
- Kiln (sys/kiln): optional Python execution and a separate private SQLite interpreter; runtime downloads, cancellation, and egress limits are documented in sys/kiln/README.md.
- Anvil (apps/anvil): projects, tasks, structured tools, shell dispatch, hooks, protected paths, and optional task verification commands.
- Forge (apps/forge): terminal access to the same shell and agent loop.

## Read next
- docs/desktop-reference.md — desktop modes, storage, AI, egress, app catalog, mirroring, and SDK vendoring.
- docs/app-contract.md — host SDK and app integration contract.

- .github/workflows/test.yml — full verification commands; Node 24 and Chrome requirements.

## Constraints
No build step: JavaScript ES modules and pinned vendored dependencies.
Browser capabilities determine available storage and runtime paths. The shell does not launch host processes or promise full POSIX/GNU compatibility.
Local tools remain usable without model inference.
